newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse to change index composition.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse to change index composition.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said it will increase the number of shares the BUX index basket contains to 25 from the current 23, as of September 30.
The changed BUX will not include the agricultural holding company Agrimpex Rt and the grocery retailer Global Rt, but four new shares will be added to the index basket.
The new stocks will be chemicals companies Tiszai Vegyi Kombinat Rt (TVK) and Borsodchem Rt, packaging materials maker Cofinec SA, and hotel chain Eravis.

Thus the index basket will include Borsodchem, Cofinec, Csopak, Danubius, Domus, Dunaholding, Egis, Eravis, Fotex, Globus, Goldsun, Graboplast, Human, Inter-Europa Bank, MOL, OTP Bank, Pannonplast, Pick, Primagaz, Richter, Skala-Coop T, Styl, TVK, Zalakeramia, Zwack.
The 25 stocks of which the changed BUX will be made up accounts for 97 percent for the capitalization of all shares traded or listed on the BSE, the bourse said.
The bourse will publish the detailed weighted composition of the new index basket on September 27.
